command.name: security key-manager external barbican update-config
command.description: This command provides a way to update the attributes of a Barbican configuration.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver of the Barbican configuration to be updated.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the name of the Barbican configuration to be updated.

parameter.name: proxy-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy type.

parameter.name: proxy-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy host.

parameter.name: proxy-port
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy port.

parameter.name: proxy-username
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy username.

parameter.name: proxy-password
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the proxy password.

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the timeout, in seconds, for attempting to connect to the Barbican instance.

parameter.name: verify
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the verify value of the Barbican configuration. The verify value can be either true or false.

parameter.name: verify-host
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the verify-host value of the Barbican configuration. The verify value can be either true or false.

example.p: The following example updates the verify value to false for the Barbican configuration "config1" associated with the data Vserver v1.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager external barbican update-config -vserver v1 -config-name config1 -verify false
